headline: Public hearing on laying out right-of-way over 1720 Spear Street, plus an executive session on the City Manager's evaluation.
summary: The meeting will hold a public hearing on laying out right-of-way shown on the Official City Map over 1720 Spear Street. It will also consider an executive session to evaluate the City Manager.
items: Comments and questions from the public not related to the agenda
Public hearing on laying out right-of-way depicted on Official City Map over 1720 Spear Street
Documents: cover sheet for public hearing, City Attorney public memo on 1720 Spear, and notice of examination of premises and public hearing
Consider entering into executive session under 1 V.S.A. 313(a)(3) to discuss evaluation of a public official, specifically the City Manager
plain_text:
City Council Special Meeting Agenda
NOVEMBER 6, 2026
Participation Options
l In Person: 12:00 PM | 180 Market Street, Main Floor, Auditorium 
l Assistive Listening Service Devices available upon request  
l Electronically: https://zoom.us/j/97028862277 
l You can also dial in using your phone 929 205 6099 Webinar ID: 970 2886 2277
Pledge of Allegiance (12:00 pm)
Agenda Review: Additions, deletions or changes in order of agenda items (12:01 pm)
Comments and questions from the public not related to the agenda (12:03 pm)
Hold a Public Hearing to institute proceedings regarding the laying out of right-of-way 
depicted on Official City Map over 1720 Spear Street - Colin McNeil, City Attorney, Erica 
Towle, Director of Public Works (12:05 pm)
4A. COVER SHEET - PUBLIC HEARING 11.6.26.PDF
4B. CITY ATTORNEY PUBLIC MEMO TO CITY COUNCIL - 1720 SPEAR.PDF
4C. NOTICE OF EXAMINATION OF PREMISES AND PUBLIC HEARING.PDF
Other Business (12:15 pm)
Consider entering into executive session pursuant to 1 V.S.A. 313(a)(3) for the purpose of 
discussing the evaluation of a public official and specifically the City Manager (12:20 pm)
Adjourn
Respectfully submitted:
Jessie Baker
City Manager
Please NOTE:  All times are estimates.
